verdict.rationale: Rive documents its own AI agent inside the Editor that can take on design, animation and coding tasks, including generating scripts, responsive layouts, data models and animation. The MCP and RML/CLI items cover external agents, not the built-in assistant, so they are not credited here. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how the in-editor agent is invoked and what its limits are, independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Rive's AI agent helps you write code, design, and animate.
Generate scripts, responsive layouts, data models, and even animation.
